newsitem.title: USA: Exsorbet says 95 pct of debentures convert.
newsitem.headline: Exsorbet says 95 pct of debentures convert.

text.p: Exsorbet Industries Inc, an environmental services company, said on Thursday that 95 percent of the $5 million in convertible debentures it issued in May has been converted into common stock.
As of November 18, the company had converted $4.8 million of the debentures into stock, it said.
An Exsorbet spokesman said about 2.0 million shares were issued in connection with the debenture conversions.
The debentures were converted at a variable price in the $2-$2.25 a share range, the spokesman said.
